student_learning_journey.problem_investigation: As an engineering student, I explored how long-duration spaceflight hazards (RIDGE) break standard terrestrial medical assumptions. Deep space missions make real-time telemedicine impossible due to speed-of-light delays (up to 22 min to Mars).
student_learning_journey.engineering_hypothesis: Can we build an offline-first, low-power edge medical system that equips non-physician astronauts with the autonomous diagnostic capability of an onboard flight surgeon?
key_innovations: 1. Zero-dependency architecture runnable on any spacecraft browser terminal.
2. Live interactive NASA PVT-B cognitive reaction testing directly in the UI.
3. Direct integration of NASA Twins Study and MSL Curiosity RAD datasets.
4. Deterministic SANS Frisén staging and NASA REID mathematical cancer risk models.
5. Gamified countermeasure protocol to counteract behavioural isolation lethargy.
